cases.title: Clicking Add note button creates and appends a single note
cases.description: Verify that when the user clicks the Add note button, a new note is created and appended to the document body as a div element with the class note containing a visible, empty textarea with data-testid="note-textarea".

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks on Add note button create separate notes
cases.description: Verify that the application supports multiple rapid clicks on the Add note button, with each click creating a separate note containing its own textarea.

cases.title: Dynamic real-time Markdown rendering
cases.description: Verify that as the user types Markdown into the textarea, the content is dynamically rendered in real-time with proper HTML formatting in the main display area.

cases.title: Handling invalid Markdown without crashes
cases.description: Verify that the app handles complex and invalid Markdown (such as unmatched **) without causing crashes or errors, displaying the raw input when exiting the edit mode by clicking the edit button.

cases.title: Local storage persistence of note changes during edits
cases.description: Verify that all changes made while editing a note are reflected immediately in local storage to persist the current state of the note.

cases.title: New Note Enters Edit Mode Immediately upon Creation
cases.description: Verify that when the user creates a new note by clicking the "Add note" button, the note immediately enters edit mode where the textarea is visible and the main content area remains hidden.

cases.title: Switching Between Edit and View Modes via Edit Button
cases.description: Verify that users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the "Edit" button, which toggles the visibility of the textarea and the main content area accordingly.

cases.title: Automatic Saving of Note Changes to Local Storage
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking the delete button (data-testid="delete-note-button") removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes its corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Retrieve and display saved notes from localStorage on page load
cases.description: When the Notes App webpage loads, it retrieves saved notes from localStorage and dynamically creates a div element with the class note containing tools, an "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), a "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button"), a main div (data-testid="note-main") with content displayed, and a hidden textarea for notes that have content.

cases.title: Display textarea and hide main div for notes with no content on page load
cases.description: When notes retrieved from localStorage have no content, the application displays the textarea and hides the main div for immediate editing.

cases.title: Handle empty localStorage on page load
cases.description: When the Notes App webpage loads and localStorage is empty, no notes are shown.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and scenarios are accurately covered by the provided test cases without any blockers or missing explicit scenarios.
All requirements and explicit scenarios are fully and correctly covered by the proposed test cases. No blockers or coverage gaps found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1 contains multiple behaviors: creating a single note via button click, appending it as a <div> with class "note" and a textarea, and supporting multiple rapid clicks to create separate notes. It also specifies abnormal/edge conditions for rapid clicking. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2 contains multiple behaviors: dynamic Markdown rendering in real-time, handling complex and invalid Markdown without crashes, raw input display when exiting edit mode, and local storage persistence. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3 contains multiple behaviors: creating a note upon page load or button click entering edit mode immediately, switching between edit and view modes via the "Edit" button toggling visibility of the textarea and main area, and automatic saving to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4 contains multiple behaviors: removing the targeted note from the DOM upon clicking the delete button and removing the corresponding entry from localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5 contains multiple behaviors: retrieving saved notes from localStorage on page load, dynamically rendering note elements with tools, main div, and textarea, rendering notes with content in the main div (textarea hidden), showing textarea and hiding main div for empty notes, handling empty localStorage state, and utilizing the internal notes variable from JSON.parse.
